speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Thou art back inside the middle. I had begun to think the beans would have to start without thee.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Mine reached the real arch. Judith's rested. That is the race, and I am not telling it smaller.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: She rested because the song ended. A rest is not a loss. The name stays mine.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The book came home dry. I am not asking my question at a board full of boats.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not ask it. I had one answer at the reeds, and it was that the book does not say. I am not making a second.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The cloth is where we left it. Open it, if a corner must prove it can survive an hour of not being looked at.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: It has survived. Sit, the three of you. I have you now. Thy father and thy mother are for the path.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: We could come as far as the stile.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Thou couldst not. Joan has the three of you. The path is not a procession.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Then the boats stay on the step, where a person can see they were real.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: On the step. Not in the hall. I am not explaining three hulls to the shop.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I will put the book on the shelf. I am not putting the question there. It can wait.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Let it wait. I have beans, and I have three pairs of wet hems, and I have no room for a wall.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Will. The knife.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In the belt. Three hulls, and home. I am not carrying a loss.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Go, the pair of you, while there is light enough for a path. I have them.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Tell Bartholomew the arch was a real arch.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I will tell him nothing of an arch. Eat what is in the cloth when Joan says the hour. We are gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The middle is spent. The path is the next thing, and it is not a story for the step.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I heard the end of it at the reeds. I am not making you say the middle again.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Good. Then nobody is saying it. The beans have been patient enough for one Sunday.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The boats can stay on the step. They are not invited to the beans.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Joan says the step, so the step. I have told the arch.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The step. Come, Will. I want the hedge while I can still see it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The knife is home. The three are yours. We are going.
